representation: A sorted five-cell array with low, mid and high tags, plus fading of discarded cells after each comparison.
motion: Tags jump to the new bounds after each comparison; discarded cells and their labels fade, while the target label stays fixed.
controls: state timeline with pause/continue checkpoints; no numeric slider
checkpoints: midpoint 9 and 14 are not the target
misconceptionTest: The first midpoint is 9 and the second is 14, not the target 23, so midpoint does not imply answer. A checkpoint explains that fading a half is valid only because the array is sorted.
accessibility: Alt text; keyboard play/pause and checkpoints; excluded cells fade but are also named in the status line, and low, mid and high are text labels rather than colors alone.
